pages.text: Use the empty core with an empty hand to cycle recipe ghosts. Use each ingredient on its cell's top face to deposit one; use the cell empty-handed to take it back. Quarter-turn rotations work. Keep unused cells clear. Each of the four equipment entries has a 5×5 layout.

As an infected survivor, stand close to an edge at the base level. Sneak-use the rim empty-handed and stand still for about 4.8 seconds. When infusion finishes, ingredients and biomass are spent. Take the result from the core. Moving away cancels the channel.
